description: pixel art interior landscape, an old village kitchen: a big clay stove with a low fire and a black cauldron, a wooden table with bread, vegetables and a fish on a board, strings of onions and garlic hanging from the beams, clay pots on shelves, thin ice-blue glowing crystal shards and faint luminous blue lines along the walls, soft warm light, wide panorama for a dim background behind text, low contrast, muted dark palette of deep browns and greens with ice-blue accents, no text, no border, no people, no animals
